meta.name: antinet-security-scan
meta.description: 信息安全分析师与软件开发工程师在搭建文档处理流水线时，当需要拦截违规文件或外部URL，请挂载此技能作为强制前置安检，自动输出 pass/reject 判定与详细合规扫描报告，一键守住零信任安全底线。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动拦截文档流水线中的违规文件与外部URL，输出合规扫描报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在搭建文档处理流水线，需要拦截违规文件或外部URL以保障安全。
copy.tagline_en: Block bad files and URLs in document pipelines and output compliance reports.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build document pipelines and need to block bad files or URLs for security.

howto.what: 进入流水线的文件和外部 URL 会先被安检,违规对象被拦截;它会输出 pass 或 reject 判定,以及含黑名单命中项、许可状态和风险等级的扫描报告,并生成 trace_id 供留痕。
howto.when: 当文档处理流水线收到本地文件或外部 URL 时,该技能作为第一道闸门接管,负责域名黑名单、OA 许可校验与可疑来源拦截等。

say.text: 扫描这个文件,给出 pass 还是 reject 判定
检查这个 URL 的域名是否命中黑名单
换用这份 policy_ref 规则集重新扫描

howto.what_en: Before files or external URLs enter the pipeline, it screens them and blocks violations; it outputs a pass/reject verdict plus a scan report with blacklist hits, license status and risk level, and a trace_id.
howto.when_en: It takes over as the first gate when a document pipeline receives a local file or an external URL, handling domain blacklists, OA license checks and suspicious-source blocking.

say_en.text: Scan this file and give me a pass or reject verdict
Check whether this URL's domain is on the blacklist
say_en.note: Hits are written into the report

say_en.text: Re-scan this with this policy_ref rule set
